paragraphs.text:
You urge Sylvia to bring hot soup for the stranger. While you 
stand looking at him, unease builds in your stomach. His face is 
repulsive and oddly proportioned.

Make an Anthropology roll: if you succeed, go to 176, if you fail, 
go to 179.
